title: Seacrest Sweet Caroline 30A Panama City Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewHot TubLarge Penthouse unit overlooking Seacrest Lagoon Pool / Expansive Private Patio / Close to Shops & restaurants / BikesThe Space Sweet Caroline 30A – Luxurious Penthouse Overlooking Seacrest Lagoon Pool! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Penthouse Condo – Entire Top Floor – Offers expansive views of Seacrest Beach & Lagoon Pool Lagoon Pool Just Steps Away – 12,000 sq. ft. resort-style pool right outside your door Short Walk to the Beach – Or take the complimentary seasonal tram service Spacious Private Balcony – Breathtaking views & outdoor dining for 4 4 Bedrooms / 3.5 Bathrooms – Accommodates up to 10 guests comfortably 2 King Suites with En-Suite Bathrooms – Spa-like luxury with Jacuzzi tub & walk-in shower Private Balconies off Guest Bedrooms – Enjoy fresh coastal breezes & serene views Open-Concept Living, Dining & Kitchen – High-end finishes, quartz countertops & stainless steel appliances Flat Screen TVs & High-Speed Wi-Fi – Stay entertained & connected 4 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic paths & nearby attractions Elevator Access to Private Penthouse Entry – Easy & convenient access Designated Parking – Hassle-free parking for your stay Walking Distance to Shops & Restaurants – Prime location in Seacrest Beach Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to Sweet Caroline 30ADiscover the ultimate beach getaway at "Sweet Caroline 30A," a luxurious penthouse condo perfectly situated in the heart of Seacrest Beach along scenic Highway 30A. Overlooking a stunning resort-style lagoon pool and just a short walk from the sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, this property promises an unforgettable vacation experience.From the moment you step into "Sweet Caroline 30A," you’ll feel like you’ve found your forever vacation spot. This stunning penthouse is designed to provide the utmost comfort and style, accommodating up to ten guests across four beautifully appointed bedrooms. Each space is thoughtfully crafted to ensure a restful and luxurious stay.The master bedroom serves as a serene retreat, featuring a plush king-sized bed and ample space for relaxation. It is complemented by an en-suite master bathroom that exudes spa-like luxury, complete with a Jacuzzi tub for indulgent soaks and a separate walk-in shower, offering both convenience and elegance.The first guest bedroom also boasts a king-sized bed, includes a private en-suite bathroom equipped with a tub-shower combo, allowing for ultimate privacy and convenience. Additionally, this room opens up to a private balcony, where guests can enjoy their own peaceful outdoor space. The second guest bedroom is equally inviting, featuring a comfortable queen-sized bed. The bedroom also has access to a private balcony, perfect for savoring the fresh coastal breeze and serene views. The final guest bedroom offers two full-sized beds, making it ideal for families with children or groups of friends.The expansive living, dining, and kitchen areas create the perfect space for gathering. Enjoy plush seating, a stylish dining table, and a modern kitchen featuring quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances—ideal for preparing meals or entertaining. Step out from the living area onto the large private, covered patio and experience seamless indoor-outdoor living. The patio offers multiple seating options, a dining table for four, and breathtaking views of Seacrest Beach and the 12,000-square-foot lagoon pool—the largest on 30A! Whether you’re sipping your morning coffee, enjoying an evening drink, or soaking up the coastal breeze, this space is a true retreat.When it’s time for some beachside relaxation, a quick stroll (just a block and across 30A) or a ride on the complimentary seasonal tram will take you straight to the shoreline with ease.If you're looking to enjoy everything 30A has to offer, from world-class beaches to vibrant local charm, "Sweet Caroline 30A" is the perfect choice for your next vacation.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Sleeping Arrangements: (Sleeps 10)- Master Bedroom: King Sized Bed / Master Bath with Jacuzzi Tub and Walk-In Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Sized Bed / Private Bathroom w/tub shower combo and access to private balcony- Guest Bedroom: Queen Sized Bed w/ a shared “Jack and Jill” bathroom with access to private balcony- Guest Bedroom: 2 Full sized beds with access to shared “Jack and Jill” bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​Show less
